title: Mahoromatic: Natsu no TV Special
justification: AniList 631 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2003-08-15) is AniDB 201's special S2 Mahoromatic Summer Special / Natsu no TV Special, aired 2003-08-15. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 277, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 201, and the special's title matches AniList's English and romaji titles. The parent's row places S2 on TVDB 0x3 Summer Special (2003-08-15) and, with the TMDB row, on TMDB 42722 S0E3 Summer Special (2003-08-15).
